LanguageData.CleanFoods_Setting_CleanThresholdDesc: At or above this room cleanliness, cooked meals have zero poison risk. Vanilla default is -2. A normal kitchen on plain flooring sits at 0.
LanguageData.CleanFoods_Setting_FilthyFloorDesc: At or below this room cleanliness, poison risk is at its maximum. Between the filthy floor and the clean threshold, risk scales linearly. Vanilla default is -5.
LanguageData.CleanFoods_Setting_MaxChanceDesc: Poison chance per meal in the filthiest kitchen (at or below the filthy floor). Vanilla default is 5%.
